policy: Fill only currently empty bilingual etiology fields for five musculoskeletal Conditions. Preserve existing pathology, risk factors, red flags, acupuncture scope, relations, and provenance; append direct official or professional sources. Keep pain syndromes etiologically heterogeneous and do not imply that a symptom label proves one structural lesion.

cond.si_joint_dysfunction.etiology_zh: 薦髂關節功能障礙／薦髂關節來源疼痛通常是多因子診斷，而非已證實的單一『錯位』。急性發作可見於跌坐、車禍、搬重物等造成的剪力或扭轉負荷；較隱匿者可與反覆單側負重、跑跳或旋轉運動、孕產期韌帶鬆弛與骨盆負荷改變，以及腰椎融合術後負荷重新分配有關。退化性骨關節炎、發炎性脊椎關節病、感染或骨盆環創傷亦可累及薦髂關節，但屬不同病因，需要個別辨識。可能的疼痛機轉包括關節囊、韌帶與周圍結構受刺激，以及過度活動、活動不足或骨盆帶穩定不足造成的負荷傳遞異常。單一理學測試或一般影像不能可靠證明薦髂關節是痛源；應以病史、成組誘發測試及必要時影像導引診斷性阻斷綜合判斷，並排除腰椎、髖部與全身性病因。
cond.si_joint_dysfunction.etiology_en: Sacroiliac joint dysfunction or SI-joint–related pain is usually multifactorial rather than proof of a single joint being “out of alignment.” Acute onset may follow a fall onto the buttocks, a motor-vehicle collision, heavy lifting, or another shear or torsional load. More insidious cases may relate to repetitive asymmetric loading, running or rotational sports, pregnancy-associated ligamentous laxity and altered pelvic load, or redistributed load after lumbar fusion. Degenerative osteoarthritis, inflammatory spondyloarthritis, infection, and pelvic-ring trauma can also involve the SI joint, but they are distinct etiologies that require separate recognition. Proposed pain mechanisms include irritation of the capsule, ligaments, or periarticular tissues and impaired load transfer from hypermobility, hypomobility, or insufficient pelvic-girdle stability. No single examination maneuver or routine image reliably proves the SI joint is the pain generator; history, a cluster of provocation tests, and—when appropriate—an image-guided diagnostic block must be integrated while lumbar, hip, and systemic causes are excluded.

cond.tfcc_injury.etiology_zh: TFCC 損傷分為急性創傷型與退化型。急性損傷常由伸手撐地跌倒、腕部尺偏時的軸向壓縮，或球拍／球棒揮擊等伴隨前臂旋轉的負荷造成，也可能合併遠端橈骨骨折或遠端橈尺關節損傷。退化型則與年齡相關組織磨耗及長期尺腕負荷有關；正尺骨變異會增加尺側負荷，可能為先天形態，也可由既往骨折癒合或手術後的橈尺長度改變造成。反覆負荷可逐步造成中央纖維軟骨退變、穿孔與鄰近軟骨病變。影像所見的 TFCC 退變或撕裂會隨年齡增加，且可存在於沒有尺側腕痛的人，因此不能單憑 MRI 異常就認定它是症狀來源；需結合受傷機轉、尺側壓痛、前臂旋轉症狀與遠端橈尺關節穩定性。
cond.tfcc_injury.etiology_en: TFCC injury has acute traumatic and degenerative pathways. Acute injury commonly follows a fall on an outstretched hand, axial compression of an ulnar-deviated wrist, or a rotational load during a racket or bat swing; it may accompany a distal-radius fracture or distal radioulnar-joint injury. Degenerative injury reflects age-related tissue attrition and chronic ulnocarpal loading. Positive ulnar variance increases ulnar-sided load and may be constitutional or develop after fracture malunion or surgery changes radioulnar length. Repetitive loading can progress from central fibrocartilage degeneration to perforation and adjacent chondral disease. TFCC degeneration or tearing becomes more common on imaging with age and may also be present in people without ulnar-sided wrist pain, so an MRI abnormality alone does not establish the symptomatic lesion; the mechanism, ulnar tenderness, rotation-related symptoms, and distal radioulnar-joint stability must be integrated.

cond.shin_splints.etiology_zh: 脛骨內側壓力症候群（MTSS，俗稱 shin splints）是反覆跑跳負荷超過脛骨及周圍組織適應與修復能力所形成的過度使用傷害，常在訓練頻率、距離、速度或強度突然增加後出現。現有模型把它視為脛骨壓力傷害連續譜的早期表現：重複軸向負荷與脛骨彎曲可累積皮質骨微損傷，並伴隨骨膜反應及鄰近肌腱附著牽拉；究竟骨膜炎或骨應力何者先發並未完全確定，因此不宜只描述成『小腿肌肉發炎』。硬或不平地面、支撐不足的鞋具及生物力學因素可增加負荷，但屬促成因素而非每位患者的單一原因。疼痛通常沿脛骨內側呈較長範圍的瀰漫壓痛；局部定點痛、靜息或夜間痛、持續惡化，應重新評估脛骨壓力性骨折，並與慢性運動性腔室症候群等其他運動誘發小腿痛區分。
cond.shin_splints.etiology_en: Medial tibial stress syndrome (MTSS, or shin splints) is an overuse injury in which repeated running or jumping load exceeds the adaptive and repair capacity of the tibia and adjacent tissues, often after a sudden increase in training frequency, distance, pace, or intensity. Current models place MTSS near the early end of a tibial bone-stress continuum: repetitive axial loading and tibial bending accumulate cortical microdamage, with periosteal reaction and traction at nearby musculotendinous attachments. Whether periosteal inflammation or bone stress comes first remains unsettled, so MTSS should not be reduced to simple “shin-muscle inflammation.” Hard or uneven surfaces, unsupportive footwear, and biomechanical factors may raise load but are contributors rather than a universal single cause. Tenderness is usually diffuse over a longer segment of the medial tibia; focal point tenderness, rest or night pain, or continued worsening should prompt reassessment for tibial stress fracture and differentiation from chronic exertional compartment syndrome and other exertional leg pain.

cond.costochondritis.etiology_zh: 肋軟骨炎是肋骨與胸骨交界處的局部疼痛性發炎／刺激；確切病因通常不明，不能把每例都歸因於感染或單次外傷。部分病例在劇烈或重複上肢活動、重咳、胸壁輕微創傷或近期呼吸道疾病後出現；少數可與血清陰性脊椎關節病、其他風濕免疫疾病或胸部手術相關。真正的化膿性感染、腫瘤及靜脈注射藥物相關胸壁感染屬不同且較少見的病因，若有發熱、紅腫、可見腫塊或全身不適，不能當成一般自限性肋軟骨炎。可重現的胸壁壓痛支持肌骨來源，但不排除心肌缺血、肺栓塞、主動脈剝離、氣胸或肺炎；因此肋軟骨炎是排除危險胸痛後的臨床診斷，而不是所有壓痛性胸痛的自動答案。
cond.costochondritis.etiology_en: Costochondritis is localized painful inflammation or irritation at a rib-to-sternum articulation. Its exact cause is usually unknown, and not every case should be attributed to infection or a single injury. Some cases follow vigorous or repetitive upper-extremity activity, severe coughing, minor chest-wall trauma, or a recent respiratory illness; a minority occur with seronegative spondyloarthritis, another rheumatic disorder, or thoracic surgery. True bacterial infection, tumor, and injection-drug–associated chest-wall infection are distinct and uncommon etiologies; fever, erythema, visible swelling, a mass, or systemic illness should not be labeled routine self-limited costochondritis. Reproducible chest-wall tenderness supports a musculoskeletal source but does not exclude myocardial ischemia, pulmonary embolism, aortic dissection, pneumothorax, or pneumonia. Costochondritis is therefore a clinical diagnosis after dangerous causes of chest pain have been considered, not the automatic explanation for every tender chest.

cond.coccydynia.etiology_zh: 尾骨痛（coccydynia）是解剖部位與症狀診斷，病因可為急性跌坐造成的挫傷、骨折或脫位，分娩相關內部創傷，或長時間坐姿、騎車等反覆微小創傷。薦尾關節或尾骨節間關節退化、韌帶受損造成的過度活動／半脫位、活動不足，以及尾骨形態或骨刺，都可能使坐姿負荷變成痛源；部分病例仍無法找到特定原因。疼痛也可能由骨盆底、腰椎、下消化道或泌尿生殖系統轉移而來。感染（如骨髓炎、膿瘍）及腫瘤（如 chordoma）罕見但不能漏診，尤其在無外傷卻持續惡化、夜間痛、發熱、腫塊或神經學異常時。所謂特發性尾骨痛應是完成適當病史、檢查及必要影像後的排除診斷，不能把所有尾骨區疼痛都推定為同一種機械性病灶。
cond.coccydynia.etiology_en: Coccydynia is an anatomic pain diagnosis with several possible etiologies. It may follow an acute fall causing contusion, fracture, or dislocation; internal trauma during childbirth; or repetitive microtrauma from prolonged sitting or cycling. Degeneration of the sacrococcygeal or intercoccygeal joints, ligament injury with hypermobility or subluxation, hypomobility, coccygeal morphology, and a distal bony spicule can make seated loading painful, while some cases remain unexplained. Pain may also be referred from the pelvic floor, lumbar spine, lower gastrointestinal tract, or urogenital system. Infection such as osteomyelitis or abscess and tumors such as chordoma are uncommon but must not be missed, particularly when nontraumatic pain progressively worsens or is accompanied by night pain, fever, a mass, or neurologic findings. “Idiopathic” coccydynia is a diagnosis of exclusion after an appropriate history, examination, and selective imaging; not every coccygeal-region pain represents the same mechanical lesion.
